progression: The Dutch OER identifies 30 introductory EC, 60 further required EC, 30 approved open elective EC, 58 integrative EC and 2 EC of tutoring and portfolio. The English programme is distinct. The catalogue places Tutoraat in its year-one group, but its course description requires three semesters and the OER awards credits only after completion, so its 2 EC are counted in year two. No duplication or overload is needed.

Year one provides 60 EC excluding Tutoraat, above the 40 EC threshold. The methods course precedes statistical reasoning and experiment. Year-two block 1 persuasion and statistics bring passed required credits to 72 before the regular second-semester internship and advice course, with both named introductory courses already complete. Internship placement and proposal approval are required. The regular first semester also includes political communication, qualitative methods and experiment, bringing the taught phases to 90 EC. Tutoring runs through this semester.

Year three uses 30 approved elective EC in semester one, then two listed 6 EC topics in blocks 4 and 5 and the 18 EC Corporate Communication graduation project in semester two. All introductory and deepening requirements are completed before the project. The topics meet the 72 EC entry rule. The two topics are required choice, not counted inside free space. The project includes team data collection and an individual thesis.
